info.name: DevMentor API — Complete Collection
info.description:
# DevMentor Backend API

**Credit-Based Mentorship & Code Review Marketplace Platform**

---

## 🚀 Quick Setup

1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to your environment:
   - **Local**: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
   - **Production**: `https://dev-mentor-server.vercel.app/api/v1`

2. Set the `token` variable after login:
   - Login → copy `token` from response → set `token` variable

3. Use `Bearer {{token}}` as the Authorization header on all protected routes.

---

## 👥 3 Roles
| Role | Email | Password |
|---|---|---|
| **Admin** | `admin@devmentor.com` | `Admin@123456` |
| **Mentor** | `mentor@devmentor.com` | `Mentor@123456` |
| **Student** | `student@devmentor.com` | `Student@123456` |

---

## 💰 Credit System
- **1 Credit = 4 BDT**
- QUICK Code Review = **10 Credits**
- DEEP Code Review = **50 Credits**
